input.title: Unisex Hamster – Cheeks Full. Plans Empty. Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

CHEEKS FULL. PLANS EMPTY. is the hamster hoodie for the owner who stocks up and then does nothing with it, worn on lazy weekends, at the pet shop and as a gift for a hamster person.

CHEEKS FULL. runs across the top in heavy slab capitals and PLANS EMPTY. stacks in two huge lines below. Between them a golden hamster sits upright with its cheeks stuffed comically wide with sunflower seeds, a few seeds spilling at its feet and a tiny exercise wheel standing empty behind it.

Navy carries cream and mustard lettering with a cream edge around the hamster; Sand gets dark brown and deep rust lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this hamster hoodie warm enough for lazy weekends and cool rooms?
Yes. The Cheeks Full. Plans Empty. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for lazy weekends, cool rooms and trips to the pet shop.

How does the Cheeks Full. Plans Empty. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt or base layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for a hamster owner?
It is a natural one. Every hamster owner has watched a pet stuff its cheeks and then sit still, so it lands with small-pet fans, classroom teachers and friends who prefer snacks to plans. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the hamster sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Cheeks Full. Plans Empty. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
